title.text: Budapest E-BeerBus Party City Tour: Unlimited Beer or Prosecco

pills.pop_html: Drinks: Unlimited Hungarian draught beer, pulled on board, is included. Prosecco and mixed-drink packages are optional extras. No outside food or drinks.
On board: Play your own playlist. Everyone has a seat with a seat belt, the bus has a roof and ventilation, and there is a toilet break on the way.

Route: From Heroes' Square down Andrássy Avenue past the Opera House to St Stephen's Basilica, Deák Square, the Budapest Eye and the Dohány Street Synagogue, then back through City Park past the Széchenyi Bath and Vajdahunyad Castle.
House rules: Costumes, nudity, smoking on board, littering, large bags and arriving drunk are not allowed. Breaking the rules after warnings ends the tour with no refund. 18+ only.
Format: Join a public tour or book the bus for your group. Hotel pick-up and an audio guide are available on request at extra cost.
The vehicle: A fully electric bus run by the original BeerBike team, with a roof, so it runs in the rain. The listing notes the old pedal BeerBikes are banned in the city.

best_for.pick_html: for the classic stag or hen afternoon: unlimited beer, your own music and the sights for €29 each, private if you book the whole bus
best_for.skip_html: if your group plans to dress up: costumes are banned on board, and the tour ends without a refund if rules are broken

title.text: Budapest: Party Cruise with DJ, Party Bus and Fast-Track Club Entry

pills.pop_html: Options: Budget (boat party only), All-Nighter (adds the Party Bus and skip-the-line entry to Morrisons 2, plus food discounts), Drinks In (adds 2.5 hours of unlimited beer, wine and long drinks) and All-In (adds a Casa Mexa taco or quesadilla box). €23 is the Budget ticket.
On board: A live DJ, a professional photographer, free bottled water and a free cloakroom. Mexican street food is sold on board.
After-party: On the All-Nighter and higher tickets, Party Bus shuttles leave every 30 minutes from 200 m from the dock to Morrisons 2 with fast-track entry.
Route: Between Margaret Bridge and Rákóczi Bridge past Parliament, Buda Castle, Gellért Hill and the Citadella, as part of a 3-hour party.

pills.summary_html: 🪪 18+, ID, no flip-flops▾
pills.pop_html: Rules: Everyone needs valid ID and must be 18+. No sandals or flip-flops, no outside food or drinks. Last boarding is 15 minutes after the start, and visibly drunk guests can be refused without a refund.
Boarding: Id. Antall József rakpart, 1051 Budapest,, on the Pest embankment. Some of the boat is outdoors, so dress for the weather.

best_for.pick_html: for the big night: a 2-hour DJ cruise past the lit-up Parliament, then a party bus and fast-track entry to Morrisons 2, from €23 each
best_for.skip_html: if you want the place to yourselves: it is a shared boat with other groups; book the private boat (#3) instead

title.text: Budapest: Sparty Night Pool Party in Széchenyi Thermal Bath

pills.pop_html: When: Every Saturday from 9.30 pm to 2 am; last entry 1 am. Running since 1994.
The party: Techno, lasers, light and fire shows and circus artists around the outdoor thermal pools of Széchenyi Bath.
Paying: Bars take only SpartyPay cards (first top-up 20,000 HUF including a 3,000 HUF deposit; no bank cards), and a reusable cup costs 700 HUF. Premium tickets include drink coupons.
Bring: Swimwear, towel, flip-flops (mandatory) and ID. A locker is included; towels and flip-flops are not.
Cancellation: Tickets cannot be refunded. 18+ only; no jumping, diving, nudity or outside drinks.
Getting there: Állatkerti körút 9–11 in City Park, about 5 minutes from the centre by metro M1. Use a taxi app afterwards.

best_for.pick_html: for the night only Budapest can do: a Saturday party in the open-air thermal pools of Széchenyi with lasers and fire shows
best_for.skip_html: if your group is not in town on a Saturday, or wants free cancellation: tickets are non-refundable
